result.note: A thin item. It tests only the regulatory point that a court ruled duty-free airport shops are subject to domestic drug law, together with the health ministry crackdown.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about developments in India in September 2026:
items: The Union health ministry ordered a crackdown on illegal nicotine pouches.
A court accepted the claim that duty-free shops at airports are immune from domestic drug law.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the court rejected Adani's claim that its duty-free airport shops were immune from domestic drug law. The health ministry's crackdown on illegal nicotine pouches followed that ruling on 28 September 2026.
questions.source: The health ministry ordered a crackdown on illegal nicotine pouches, after a court rejected Adani's claim that its duty-free airport shops were immune from domestic drug law.
